targets.query:
index="index_${env}_exch_k8s" "kubernetes.container_name"="rtr-credit-transfer-api-${env}" (message="*pacs.008*" OR message="*pacs.002*" OR message="*head.001*") message="*Settlement Commit Advice pacs.002 sent to DA*"
| rex field=message "\"clearing_system_reference\":\"(?<clearing_system_reference>[^\"]+)\""
| where clearing_system_reference="${traceabilityID}"
| timechart span=15m count

index="index_dev1_exch_k8s" "kubernetes.container_name"="rtr-credit-transfer-api-dev1" (message="*pacs.008*" OR message="*pacs.002*" OR message="*head.001*")
| rex field=message "\"error_code\":\"(?<error_code>[^\"]+)\""
| rex field=message "\"uetr\":\"(?<uetr>[^\"]+)\""
| rex field=message "\"clearing_system_reference\":\"(?<clearing_system_reference>[^\"]+)\""
| where clearing_system_reference="${traceabilityID}"
| where error_code!="NA"
| timechart span=15m distinct_count(uetr)
